arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Capture(){int n=0;float end=UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup+24;while(UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup<end){yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForEndOfFrame();if(UnityEngine.InputSystem.Mouse.current.leftButton.isPressed){var t=UnityEngine.ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshotAsTexture();System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes("scripts/button-feedback-20261111/held-"+(n++).ToString("D3")+".png",t.EncodeToPNG());UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(t);}}UnityEngine.Debug.Log("Held frames="+n);}return Capture();
arguments.summary: Capture held frames from actual mouse drag
